findings.problem: Retry dismisses persistent feedback before owner transition, including non-dismissible fallback.
findings.smallest_fix: Retry invokes owner callback only; explicit dismissal and owner lifecycle handle removal.
findings.boundary_limit: No-op retry proven in provider/providerless modes; immediate ErrorBoundary rethrow not independently reproduced with real React commits.
findings.resolution: PopupCard retry now invokes onRetry directly. No-op/blocked retry remains visible; owner lifecycle controls removal.

findings.original_code: Only success/info schedule4500ms timeout; ToastProvider outlives AuthProvider user/org updates.
findings.problem: Undismissed error/warning from old account/company remains in new context.
findings.smallest_fix: UI-only stable identity/org scope reset clears queue/timers and invalidates old captured toast callbacks.
findings.boundary_limit: This is stale UI context, not proof of server data authorization bypass.
findings.resolution: SessionToastScope wraps page subtree under AuthProvider. ToastScope binds first-render callbacks to unique per-identity generation; layout activation clears queue/timers, stale callbacks rejected, same-scope refresh preserved. StatusPopupProvider is not reset.

findings.problem: Priority-sorted host positions change keys for an unchanged dialog portal.
findings.smallest_fix: Assign stable portal identity per host; verify other-host insertion/removal does not rekey it.
findings.boundary_limit: Key instability proven; real browser focus target/announcement behavior not exercised.
findings.resolution: Provider-local WeakMap assigns stable per-host portal key; independent host priority changes preserve dialog key/container.

source_review_coverage.lifecycle: Register/update/remove tied to owner effects; owner unmount cleanup is present.
source_review_coverage.dedupe: Same notice/host/callback/action identity merges; independent retry functions remain distinct.
source_review_coverage.dismissal: Fixed: Retry no longer acknowledges error. Explicit dismiss retains stable-notice acknowledgement; owner changes/unmount control feedback lifetime.
source_review_coverage.stale_callbacks: StatusPopup handlers refresh on identity change. ToastScope generation binds on first render; old callbacks blocked after identity/org transition including returning to old account. Fresh first-render callback succeeds after activation.
source_review_coverage.host_cleanup: Nearest dialog host and stable per-host key verified structurally. Owner unmount removes portal; higher-priority body insertion/removal does not rekey existing dialog portal.
source_review_coverage.priority: Two nonprogress+oneprogress limit perhost remains, with priority and hidden count. Stable host WeakMap removes priority-driven remount.
source_review_coverage.focus: No autofocus/modal semantics on nonmodal cards; nearest-dialog portal remains within dynamic focus query and retains container/key through unrelated errors. Browser keyboard/focus tests are root-owned and not claimed here.
source_review_coverage.ssr: Document lookup is inside effect; providerless initial markup does not access document during render. Actual hydration/browser assistive-tech not exercised.

not_checked: Consumer completeness owned by other agents
verdict: Source review complete: no outstanding foundation finding after POP-01/02/03 corrections. Root owns browser, integration, critical-input contract checks and release.

test_names: progress is removed on settlement and owner unmount, including dialog scope
equivalent loaders dedupe, all progress is bounded, and errors take priority
dismiss does not cancel a request or reappear for identical rerenders
new callback and action identities refresh handlers without resurrecting dismissed feedback
independent retry actions never dedupe and retry only follows an explicit click
a blocked or failed retry keeps the unresolved error visible
another host gaining error priority preserves the existing dialog portal key
providerless recovery is a floating popup and preserves non-dismissible retry
toast notifications dedupe, bound the queue, retain errors, and clear all timers
toast scope changes clear queues and timers, reject old callbacks, and preserve first-render new callbacks
session scope keys change only for account, role, organization type or organization identity
